about: Tests that checks.st3 does not run because the Nix build sandbox cannot provide what they need. They still run in central CI (nextest, linux-tests shards) and on the wrapper path, so nothing is dropped, only moved. The check fails if an entry here no longer names exactly one test, or if any unlisted test fails. Every entry needs a reason and an owner. Running the check on a pull request head once Nix no longer starts on pull requests: `gh workflow run Nix --repo compoundingtech/smalltalk --ref BRANCH`, then take the run whose headSha is the head you mean (`gh run list --repo compoundingtech/smalltalk --workflow Nix --event workflow_dispatch --branch BRANCH --json databaseId,headSha,conclusion`). A result belongs to that exact commit only: dispatch again after every push, and never carry a result across commits.

exclusions.reason: Fails in the Nix build sandbox while it passes in central CI (linux-tests). Measured on main 24d78d71b: run alone in the sandbox at 1 and at 4 test threads, cancellation_stops_execs_and_waiting_gates_before_finally_finishes failed every time (39 s timeout waiting for the final gate). The step that never happens is the finally-step gate (final.pid) after 'missions cancel'; the mission_cancellation sibling tests that cancel without work in flight pass. Not load alone, and not systemd (the test stubs systemctl). Root cause in the sandbox not found; excluded rather than weakened.
exclusions.runs_instead: central CI linux-tests shards and the wrapper path
